page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which includes 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, enabling substantial data throughput for large-scale sequential read and write operations. No graphics processing units (GPUs) are included in this hardware profile.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge leverages mature Intel Xeon hardware to deliver exceptionally high local storage capacity per resource unit. This makes it highly suitable for workloads that require massive, cost-effective storage volumes rather than high-performance solid-state drives. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, big data analytics, and cold or warm data archiving.
